items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Willie Lynch and Chick Webb both knew me and had heard of me. They both tried to hire me.

ctx.x: How do you think you got those jobs? Were people talking about Jay C. Higginbotham, the trombone player? Were people, other musicians, talking about Jay C. Higginbotham, the trombonist, so when you came to New York to see your mother - everybody was interested in hearing you?
Yeah. Willie Lynch and Chick Webb both knew me and had heard of me. They both tried to hire me.
